title: Smoky Salad Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful salad bowl made with smoky roasted vegetables, mixed greens, and a tangy lemon vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: dressing (lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper)

instructions: Toss the sweet potatoes with a little oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, chickpeas, and roasted sweet potatoes.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the top.
Serve with lemon wedges on the side.
